question: How many days of annual leave do I get per year?
expected_answer: 25 days per year plus UK public holidays (8 in England, 9 in Scotland).

question: What is the minimum notice I need to give to book one week of leave?
expected_answer: At least 10 working days' notice for one week or less.

question: How many days of annual leave can I carry over to the next year?
expected_answer: Up to 5 days. Carried-over days expire on 31 March of the following year.

question: When does enhanced sick pay apply?
expected_answer: Enhanced sick pay (up to 10 days per year at full pay) only applies once your probation period is passed. During probation, SSP applies from day 1.
source_section: Section 5 — Sick Leave and Section 7 — Probation

question: What do I need to do on my first day of sickness?
expected_answer: Call or message your line manager directly before your usual start time. Do not just send an email — a direct message or call is required.

question: How long is the probation period?
expected_answer: 3 months. There is an informal check-in at Month 2 and a formal review at Month 3.

question: Can my probation be extended?
expected_answer: Yes, once, by up to 6 additional weeks. You will receive written confirmation and clear objectives for the extension period.

question: How much does BrightPath contribute to my pension?
expected_answer: BrightPath contributes 5% of qualifying earnings. The minimum employee contribution is 3%. The provider is Nest.

question: When does my private health insurance start?
expected_answer: Private health insurance with AXA PPP begins on the date your probation is passed. It is not available during the probation period.

question: What is the deadline for submitting an expense claim?
expected_answer: All expense claims must be submitted within 30 days of the expense being incurred. Claims after 30 days will not be reimbursed without a written exception approved by the Finance Director.

question: How many days do I need to be in the office per week?
expected_answer: A minimum of two days per week. There is no fixed requirement for which days — you coordinate with your team.

question: Can I work fully remotely?
expected_answer: Employees who wish to work fully remotely must submit a formal request to people@brightpath.io. A minimum six-month tenure is required before applying. Requests are reviewed quarterly and are not guaranteed.

question: How long can I work from abroad without approval?
expected_answer: Up to 14 days per calendar year without approval, provided it does not create a tax or employment law issue. Beyond 14 days requires written approval from your line manager and People & Culture.

question: What is my annual learning budget?
expected_answer: £1,000 per employee per year for professional development (courses, certifications, conferences). It resets each calendar year and does not roll over.

question: How do I collect my office access card on my first day?
expected_answer: In London: IT desk, Ground Floor Room G4. In Manchester: Reception desk, Level 1. In Edinburgh: Facilities office, 2nd floor. For remote starters, a temporary card is posted and arrives within 2 working days.

question: When is the deadline to complete mandatory e-learning?
expected_answer: All three mandatory e-learning modules must be completed by the end of month 1. The modules are: Data Protection & GDPR (45 min), Information Security Awareness (30 min), and Equality, Diversity & Inclusion (30 min).

question: What is the payroll date — when do I get paid?
expected_answer: Salary is paid on the last working day of each month. The first payslip covers the prorated days worked in the first partial month plus the full following month.

question: What is the deadline for submitting bank details changes for them to take effect in the same month?
expected_answer: Changes must be submitted before the 15th of the month to take effect in that month's payroll. Changes after the 15th take effect the following month.

question: What happens if I don't submit a P45 or Starter Checklist?
expected_answer: If HR does not receive a P45 or Starter Checklist, HMRC defaults to an emergency tax code (0T), which means you will pay more tax in your first month. It can be reclaimed but is easier to avoid.

question: Who should I contact for a confidential counselling service?
expected_answer: Health Assured via the Employee Assistance Programme (EAP). Call 0800 028 0199, available 24/7, up to 6 free sessions per year. Your manager and HR are not informed if you use this service.

question: Can I use my learning budget to buy a monitor?
expected_answer: No. The learning budget (£1,000/year) cannot be used for equipment. Equipment requests go through the IT portal at it.brightpath.io and require manager approval for items under £100 and Finance approval for items over £100.

question: What is the maximum gift value I can accept from a client without approval?
expected_answer: £25. Gifts from clients or suppliers worth more than £25 require prior approval from your manager.

question: How many bereavement days do I get if a parent dies?
expected_answer: 5 paid bereavement days for an immediate family member (partner, parent, child, sibling). Additional unpaid leave may be agreed with your manager.

question: I need to opt out of the pension — how long do I have to do this?
expected_answer: You are automatically enrolled from day one. To opt out, you must do so within 30 days via the Nest portal.

question: Can I work compressed hours in my first month?
expected_answer: No. Compressed working weeks are only available after your probation period is passed (3 months). You also need written approval from your line manager and HR before starting a compressed arrangement.
source_section: Section 2 — Working Hours and Section 7 — Probation

question: What core hours am I expected to be available during?
expected_answer: 10:00–16:00 UK time, Monday to Friday. You must be reachable on Slack during these hours unless you have notified your manager in advance.

question: What happens to my access card when I leave the company?
expected_answer: All company equipment, including your access card and laptop, must be returned within 5 working days of your last day. Contact it@brightpath.io to arrange the return.

question: How many volunteer days do I get per year?
expected_answer: 2 paid volunteer days per year. You must submit a request via hr.brightpath.io at least 5 working days in advance.

question: I started on 1 April — how many days of leave do I have this year?
expected_answer: You accrue 25 × (9/12) = 18.75 days, rounded up to 19 days, for the remainder of the leave year.

question: I lost my access card — will I be charged for a replacement?
expected_answer: There is no charge for a first replacement. Subsequent replacements cost £10. Report the loss immediately to your office's reception and to security@brightpath.io.
